---
title: About Me
---

Hi, I'm Palmer Maurer, a senior at Georgetown University pursuing a *Bachelor of Science* in *Mathematics*. I originally began my studies as a chemistry major on the pre-med track, but over time I discovered a deeper passion for mathematics, data science and machine learning, and this has shaped my academic and professional focus. 

I'm originally from Princeton, New Jersey, and I'm a dedicated **New York Yankees** fan, hence the theme of this project. Outside of academics, I enjoy spending time with friends and family, including my family dog, Twix. I love golfing, listening to rock (especially *The Rolling Stones* and Bruce Springsteen, for example), and playing the cello, which I've played for many years, most recenty in the GU Orchestra.

Travel is another passion of mine; **Italy** holds a special place in my heart. I've been very fortunate to visit several times with my family, and exploring every region remains a goal of mine. My family heritage is mainly Italian, with some German, Irish, and English ancestry, and I enjoy connecting with my roots through travel and food!

I'm looking forward to the rest of my senior year at Georgetown and the opportunities ahead where I hope to combine my analytical skills with problem-solving and creativity.
